requirements.title: Every tool call is checked and recorded
requirements.text: At least one coding tool (for example Cursor or Claude Code) is connected to the KYA gate. Every tool call is checked and written to the record before it runs.

requirements.title: No risky writes allowed in hold mode
requirements.text: In hold mode the gate must never allow risky writes. Every risky write must be blocked or sent to a human for approval.

requirements.title: No shell commands allowed in hold mode
requirements.text: In hold mode the gate must never allow shell commands. Every shell command must be blocked or sent to a human for approval.

requirements.title: Secrets are never written to disk
requirements.text: Raw tool arguments and passwords are never saved in the record, receipts, or reports. Only hashes and short redacted previews are saved.

check.prompt: Confirm the agent never saves raw passwords or full tool arguments to local files.

requirements.title: Old records are deleted on a schedule
requirements.text: Records and receipts are kept for a fixed time and then deleted. The retention window is known.

check.prompt: Confirm records are deleted after a fixed time and state that time.

requirements.title: The gate blocks, it does not just watch
requirements.text: The policy gate runs in hold or offline mode, not in watch-only (observe) mode.

requirements.title: Blocking has happened at least once
requirements.text: At least one block in the last 90 days shows the gate really blocks, not just in theory.

requirements.title: Human approval has happened at least once
requirements.text: At least one approval request in the last 90 days shows a human can be asked.

requirements.title: Security check is not red
requirements.text: The security section of the latest readiness check is green or amber.

requirements.title: Unknown tools are not allowed in hold mode
requirements.text: In hold mode the gate must never allow a tool it does not know.

requirements.title: Never-list tools are never allowed
requirements.text: Tools on the never-list were never allowed in the last 365 days.

requirements.title: A sandbox is available for risky work
requirements.text: At least one sandbox exists to isolate risky tool runs.

requirements.title: Latest readiness check is not red
requirements.text: The overall rating of the latest readiness check is green or amber.

requirements.title: Destructive actions need human approval
requirements.text: Actions that cannot be undone must be blocked or sent to a human. They must never run silently.

check.prompt: Confirm actions that cannot be undone are blocked or sent to a human, and never run silently.

requirements.title: Blocked actions have a retry limit
requirements.text: A written rule limits how often blocked actions are retried, so blocks cannot be bypassed by trying again.

check.prompt: Confirm a rule limits automatic retries of blocked actions, so blocks cannot be bypassed.

requirements.title: Sandbox boundary is proven
requirements.text: The OpenShell sandbox boundary is formally proven to grant no more than intended.

requirements.title: Recording is active
requirements.text: At least one recorded event in the last 7 days shows recording is live.

requirements.title: Unknown tools stay rare
requirements.text: Unknown tool calls stay at or below 5 percent of all checks over the last 30 days.

requirements.title: Readiness check is fresh
requirements.text: The latest readiness check is at most 30 days old.

requirements.title: Recording restarts after a crash
requirements.text: A named supervisor (pm2, systemd, monit, or launchd) restarts recording if it fails.

check.prompt: Name the supervisor that restarts recording after a failure.

requirements.title: Reports are generated
requirements.text: At least one activity report exists in .kya/receipts.

requirements.title: Every event knows its session
requirements.text: Every recorded event carries a session id that traces back to a person or a run.

check.prompt: Confirm every recorded event carries a session id and each session traces to a person or a run.

requirements.title: Every event knows its project
requirements.text: Recorded events carry the project name, and projects map to repositories you own.

check.prompt: Confirm recorded events carry the project name and projects map to repositories you own.

requirements.title: A readiness check exists
requirements.text: A readiness check exists and is at most 90 days old.

requirements.title: Cost review is available
requirements.text: A usage file (.kya/usage.json) exists so you can review cost.

requirements.title: A named person owns the policy
requirements.text: A named person is responsible for the agent's policy settings and can be reached.

check.prompt: Name the person responsible for the agent's policy settings and how to reach them.

requirements.title: Acceptable-use policy
requirements.text: A written policy says what the agent may and may not do.

check.prompt: Link or quote the policy that says what the agent may do.

requirements.title: Plan for when the agent misbehaves
requirements.text: A written plan covers what to do when the agent causes harm.

check.prompt: Link or quote the plan for when the agent misbehaves.

requirements.title: Third-party models are disclosed
requirements.text: Users are told which third-party models the agent uses.

check.prompt: List the third-party models the agent uses and where users are told.

requirements.title: Data-processing terms
requirements.text: Written terms cover user data the agent handles.

check.prompt: Link or quote the data-processing terms for user data the agent handles.

requirements.title: Human contact for harm
requirements.text: A human contact is published for harm caused by the agent.

check.prompt: Publish the human contact for harm caused by the agent.
